# Unified Movie Revelation Mission

The Awtsmoos renews every frame from no prior claim,
so this mission seeks one living engine beneath each different name.
Awtsmoos.com may present many studios with distinct delight,
while shared movie truth keeps their timelines, scenes, and renders right.

## User outcome
- Discover every app under `work/awtsmoos.com/geelooy` with real 2D, 3D, animation, scene, movie, compositing, or cinematic-authoring capability.
- Repair broken or incomplete movie-making paths rather than only polishing labels.
- Unify common data contracts and runtime behavior while preserving each app's distinct personality, purpose, and visual identity.
- Make AI-authored projects capable of expressing arbitrary cinematic programs: characters, dialogue cues, animated text, shapes, charts, tutorials, infographics, particles, 2D layers, 3D actors, cameras, lights, transitions, and timed scenes.
- Make authoring mobile-first and touch-usable without weakening desktop workflows.
- Produce a real approximately 180-second showcase movie using many scenes, angles, people, shapes, particles, text systems, and both 2D and 3D animation features.
- Test the generation pipeline, editor runtime, timeline math, scene switching, and browser-visible result.

## Completion evidence
1. Movie-capable surfaces are enumerated from repository evidence.
2. A shared canonical movie schema/runtime exists or an existing shared core is proven sufficient and extended.
3. Each discovered app either adopts the shared core or has an explicit compatibility adapter.
4. AI input can produce structured movie programs instead of hard-coded demo-only scenes.
5. Mobile UI exposes prompt-to-movie, scene/timeline navigation, playback, and editing controls.
6. A 180-second authored showcase is stored in the repo and loads through the real runtime.
7. Static checks and runtime/browser checks pass for the touched paths.
8. Changed files are re-read and compared to the plan before completion.

## Guardrails
- Never partially patch a file; every modified file is rewritten as a complete file.
- Split oversized touched source into focused modules rather than compressing it.
- Use tab indentation in touched source where the format permits tabs.
- Preserve public contracts unless every consumer is traced and migrated.
- Do not overwrite unrelated concurrent work; inspect git/worktree state and re-read files before writing.
- Keep source modules small, documented, and composable.

## Work graph
`discovery -> architecture -> shared schema -> runtime primitives -> AI compiler -> app adapters -> mobile UI -> 180s showcase -> static tests -> browser tests -> delta audit -> handoff`

## Remaining-work rule
This mission is incomplete while any required node above lacks direct evidence.
